title: Fix headless import/export reporting progress greater than 100%
body:
Fixes #108993. This effectively changes the single step counter introduced in #105770 to now be multiple counters instead, with one per task. This is pretty much exactly what `EditorNode::progress_dialog` (which tracks progress of background tasks in non-headless mode) seems to be doing already. Here's what the output from `--headless --import` with the MRP in #108993 looks like with this change:
